sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Speed

FACT_ID: sec06-R01 | anchor: FXsec06R01
Sit upright without tensing; position your hands at eight and four on an imagined clock face. Grip the steering wheel with fingers and thumbs rather than your palms [FXsec06R01].
Why it matters: group speed-control; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F01 [FXsec06R01].
Source: [FXsec06R01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec06-R02 | anchor: FXsec06R02
For passenger vehicles and motorcycles, default maxima are twenty-five miles per hour in school, business and residential areas, thirty-five on unpaved roads and fifty-five elsewhere, unless a speed sign sets another limit [FXsec06R02].
Why it matters: group speed-limits; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec06-F06 [FXsec06R02].
Source: [FXsec06R02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec06-R03 | anchor: FXsec06R03
A speed limit sets the highest lawful road speed when conditions are ideal [FXsec06R03].
Why it matters: group speed-risk; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F03, sec06-F04 [FXsec06R03].
Source: [FXsec06R03 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec06-R04 | anchor: FXsec06R04
Speed limits are legal ceilings for ideal conditions. Active school or work-zone restrictions, construction or bad weather can require a lower speed [FXsec06R04].
Why it matters: group speed-limits; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F05, sec06-F06 [FXsec06R04].
Source: [FXsec06R04 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec06-R05 | anchor: FXsec06R05
An active school or work-zone speed sign requires slower travel; construction or bad weather also requires slowing when the posted speed would be unsafe [FXsec06R05].
Why it matters: group speed-limits; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F07 [FXsec06R05].
Source: [FXsec06R05 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec06-R06 | anchor: FXsec06R06
Travel below the speed limit is allowed provided it does not obstruct the normal movement of traffic [FXsec06R06].
Why it matters: group speed-control; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F08 [FXsec06R06].
Source: [FXsec06R06 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec06-R07 | anchor: FXsec06R07
The manual divides stopping distance into three factors: perception time, reaction distance and braking distance. Wet pavement can make braking distance twice as long [FXsec06R07].
Why it matters: group stopping-model; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec06-F09, sec06-F10 [FXsec06R07].
Source: [FXsec06R07 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec06-R08 | anchor: A02
Bus reds and the stop arm stop traffic from both directions, while a separation or median between the roadways releases the far side [A02].
Why it matters: group school-bus; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec06-F12, sec06-F13 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec06-R09 | anchor: FXsec06R09
Unless signs set a different limit, passenger vehicles and motorcycles may travel no faster than twenty-five miles per hour in school, business and residential areas [FXsec06R09].
Why it matters: group school-bus; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F13, sec06-F14 [FXsec06R09].
Source: [FXsec06R09 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0017]
